content_sections.heading: NLIU Bhopal Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the NLIU Bhopal Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Office Assistants: Graduate Degree with knowledge of Computer Applications and proficiency in English Language. One Year Experience/ LL.B. Degree. Network Assistant: Diploma in Networking or a Two-Year (02) ITI Certificate Course in Network Technician or Computer Maintenance Programme. One Year Experience in relevant area. Multitasking Staff: Higher Secondary (10+2).

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by National Law Institute University, Bhopal (NLIU Bhopal) for various contractual posts.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this NLIU Bhopal recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Office Assistants, Network Assistant, and Multitasking Staff, offering diverse opportunities for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced for these posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies across the different posts, including 5 for Office Assistants, 1 for Network Assistant, and 3 for Multitasking Staff.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for NLIU Bhopal recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is "Walk-in". Candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for these positions?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview and skill test are scheduled for 24 September 2026. Candidates should report well in advance.

faq.question: Q6. What are the qualifications required for Office Assistants?
faq.answer: Candidates for Office Assistants must have a Graduate Degree with computer application knowledge, English proficiency, and one year of experience or an LL.B. Degree.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Multitasking Staff?
faq.answer: The Multitasking Staff position offers a fixed salary of Rs. 12,000/- per month. Salaries for other posts are negotiable.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for NLIU Bhopal recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment, making it accessible to all.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts at NLIU Bhopal?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview and a Skill Test to assess the candidates' suitability for the respective roles.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. The exact venue details should be confirmed from the official notification.
